quote: I’m sorry that this had to be this way but when you have this many bugs at the start of the release I definitely don’t think that this game deserves a 99. 20 FPS most of the time is ridiculous. Not to mention it’s also 80 dollars.

author: Snowboarder08
quote: I actually cannot believe how great **** this is. From the first trailer I was so excited to play and I got it on launch day. I am happy to say all my expectations were met and even exceeded. I have 100% this game and at this put in around 40 hours. From starting with collecting every spiritual stone as a child then unlocking link as an adult with the master sword in the temple of time and helping restore hyrule with the hero who had a destiny that missed 7 years of his life, it is just perfect. and the ending as you walk up to Ganondorfs Castle it feels so cool displaying dark fantasy in the best way. Not to mention the ending is really something that had brought me to tears. I could not state anymore how great **** this really was. If you have been questioning trying zelda but don't know where to start I recommend this game fully. It really will be a experience you will never forget I promise you.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Snowboarder08
quote: MILD SPOILERS: Alright so I just want to say for anyone saying, "This game is 70$ dollar dlc" "There's no innovation". Just stop your embarrassing yourselves at this point because they have not only changed hyrule up a lot they've added two new areas to explore being the depths and the sky islands. On top of that though with links new zonai abilities you are given so much freedom that it almost feels like you can do anything or build anything. Also the story is so interesting and it makes you want to explore the world in depth and find all the information you can. When I played Breath Of The Wild for the first I got lost in it's world explore in the vast open hyrule. This get's expanded on even more whether finding new towns, finding the changes of hyrule, the whole underground map, the sky islands and the list goes on. They also added dungeons back which was obviously exciting for many (Myself included). The bosses being more diverse rather than fighting blight ganons. Speaking of ganondorf he's back and looking better than ever before. I would say more but don't want to spoil too much so I'm gonna rap it up. I 100% recommend you won't regret it .
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
